measurement_rules.actual_usage: unique provider request receipt; prompt+completion, cache within prompt; per member and usage purpose
measurement_rules.content_tokens: fixed local tokenizer plain content; not chat context and never added to provider usage
measurement_rules.source_reads: object+version+path+full hash+range; same member and cross member overlaps separately; overlap not waste
measurement_rules.presentation: exact actual request tool result or observed addressed message; summarized source mapping remains unknown
measurement_rules.R_use: eligible published partner code relative to member_001 final integrator; receive/adopt, same-version real public test, explicit final integration lineage separately; own-source review separately
measurement_rules.sidecar: append-only hash chain plus content addressed private blobs; never added to model inputs
measurement_rules.coverage: measurement error/unknown mapping quarantines metrics only, no model retry or budget increase

validation_boundary: SDK controls used clearly labelled fixture content counter, local official tokenizer separately loaded; formal runtime require_content_counter=True enforced
additional_runtime_bridge_control: actual read_work_event return is not model presentation until its exact tool result enters a subsequent dispatched request
observer_storage_failure_control: observer event failure plus diagnostic log failure remains local; no transport rethrow and no added budget
